name: devava-notes-editor
description: CodeMirror 6, Excalidraw and Mermaid for the WebViews of Devava Notes. After changing main.js, draw.js or diagrams.js: npm install, npm run build, and commit the bundles.

scripts.build: esbuild main.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=safari16 --outfile=../src/main/resources/com/devavaxp/notes/editor.js && esbuild diagrams.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=safari16 --outfile=../src/main/resources/com/devavaxp/notes/diagrams.js && node copy-katex.mjs && node build-draw.mjs
